m40 t2: behaviour 2's reproduction (the group heading under Nov 12) does not reproduce on a faithful Dhaka app: Group::keyFor reads the model's Carbon, which Eloquent parses in PHP's default zone, the app's. Only a test that sets config without date_default_timezone_set sees Nov 12. The red lines were the subtotal and the Placed filter (dayBounds in UTC); tests use the appTimezone() helper in tests/Pest.php, which moves both.

# plan: m40-dates

- [x] t1 Count a record in a value widget and a trend on the day and hour the app stored it, whatever the app's and the user's zones, with a UTC app's SQL unchanged
- [x] t2 Cut a day group's subtotal, a date filter and a card's Open records link on the same stored days as the dashboard  [after: t1]
- [ ] t3 Store an imported datetime in the app's zone and an imported date-only cell as its calendar day
- [ ] t4 Export a date-only column as its calendar day, so export then import leaves dates unchanged  [after: t3]
- [ ] t5 Give the workbench Products a date-only Released column its import reads, read BENCH_APP_TIMEZONE, and correct the docs on what a date time field stores  [after: t1, t2, t3, t4]
